verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls, or data-deletion API for GrowthBook. The closest items are adjacent: SDK attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook, the product can be self-hosted, and it queries your own warehouse. These limit what data GrowthBook holds, but they are not controls over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: The actual values of targeting attributes (e.g., user IDs, emails) are never sent to GrowthBook. They are only stored in memory locally within the SDK.
Run GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, including MongoDB, the API, and the front-end.
